# Tournaments.com

> > Comprehensive sports tournament platform covering live schedules, rankings, news, and fantasy leagues across soccer, esports, swimming, motorsports, and traditional sports.

Tournaments.com aggregates tournament coverage, player rankings, and sports news across multiple disciplines including major leagues (Premier League, Champions League), esports (CS2), and Olympic-level competitions. The platform also offers free fantasy sports leagues and real-time event scheduling.

## Key Topics

- Tournament Coverage
- Soccer/Football
- Fantasy Sports
- Player Rankings
- Sports News
- Champions League
- Premier League
- Esports
- College Sports
- Multi-Sport Events
- Injury Recovery
- Weekly Schedule
- Cricket
- Golf
- Horse Racing

## Core Platforms

- [Tournaments.com Homepage](https://tournaments.com): Sports tournaments, news, scores, player rankings across major leagues
- [What's On - Sports Schedule](https://tournaments.com/whats-on): Weekly sports schedule and events calendar across multiple sports
- [Fantasy Sports Leagues](https://tournaments.com/fantasy): Free fantasy sports leagues for NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL with team management

## Major Tournaments

- [English Premier League 2025-26](https://tournaments.com/tournaments/bfa9fb68-1ac4-472f-831f-fc10ff5e949e): English Premier League 2025-26: 20 clubs, $2.5B prize pool, live coverage
- [Formula 1 World Championship 2026](https://tournaments.com/tournaments/452a7ffa-ca7a-4612-9f2e-6dafa6921ed3): F1 2026 Championship: 24 Grand Prix races, $140M prize pool, new regulations
- [UEFA Europa League Round of 16](https://tournaments.com/tournaments/9bba0337-d090-443e-98f3-d259860ed813): UEFA Europa League Round of 16 first leg: 16 teams advance to quarters
- [CS2 Major Copenhagen 2026](https://tournaments.com/tournaments/d1492ba3-aded-48e1-b8f3-9325a3d55a0f): CS2 Major Copenhagen 2026: 24 teams, $1M prize pool, esports championship
- [World Swimming Championships 2026](https://tournaments.com/tournaments/50f92a38-10d2-42dc-aad0-b709f954e631): World Swimming Championships 2026: 2000+ athletes, 190+ countries, $3M pool
